thread:
li-chen: Heads up — brought up SigmaLite-v1 q4 quant on staging and ran our multilingual smoke suite (CN/JP/AR samples). Unexpected tokenization / rendering hiccup in mixed scripts.
kenji: what kind of hiccup? short log pls
li-chen: BLEU dropped ~3.2 on ja-zh subset vs float32 baseline. Also seeing furigana/ruby being split off (kana becomes separate tokens) and arabic bracket mirroring when Arabic spans are embedded in Japanese lines. Example outputs below:
marcos: yikes, sample please
li-chen: sample (float32):
> 私は（太郎）さんと一緒に行きました。
> 他人: 他の人(太郎)さん

sample (q4):
> 私は（ 太郎 ）さん と 一緒 に 行 き ま し た 。
> 他人: 他 の 人 ( 太郎 ) さん

and mixed AR/JP case (float32):
> 会議は「مرحبا (مرحبا)」で始まりました。

q4 -> brackets mirrored and RTL span detached:
> 会議 は 「 )مرحبا( مرحبا 」 で 始 ま り ま し た 。

li-chen: Ran token-level diffs: q4 model inserts spaces between kana graphemes and treats parentheses around Arabic spans as separate tokens that get reordered by the detokenizer when bidi heuristics run.
aisha: could be tokenization mapping change from quant kernels? maybe a different tokenizer table got used
kenji: did you pin tokenizer version? config mismatch possibility
li-chen: tokenizer was pinned to v2.1 in the config, same as baseline. But the quant build introduced a small custom merge pass in the detokenizer (we added an experimental join heuristics to reduce merges for long runs). I suspect the heuristic interacts badly with bidi-aware reflow.
marcos: can you run a quick repro with q8 and q4 but same detok flags? put commands here
li-chen: running now. Commands used:
```
# smoke eval
python tools/eval_multilang.py --model sigma-lite-v1 --quant q4 --tokenizer v2.1 --detok-heuristic experimental --testset tests/multilingual_subs.tsv --out out/q4-smoke.json
python tools/eval_multilang.py --model sigma-lite-v1 --quant q8 --tokenizer v2.1 --detok-heuristic experimental --testset tests/multilingual_subs.tsv --out out/q8-smoke.json
python tools/eval_multilang.py --model sigma-lite-v1 --quant float32 --tokenizer v2.1 --detok-heuristic stable --testset tests/multilingual_subs.tsv --out out/fp32-smoke.json
```
eval-bot: q4 job finished: BLEU ja-zh 21.3, fp32 24.5, q8 23.9. Per-sentence diffs queued at /ci/artifacts/2798765432/q4_diffs.txt
kenji: thanks. if q8 is closer to fp32 that points to extreme quant noise in q4 kernels. but the detok flag difference for fp32 worries me — we need apples-to-apples
li-chen: agreed. I re-ran fp32 with experimental detok and got BLEU 24.2 (stable 24.5). So detok heuristics move score ~0.3, but q4 still big gap.
aisha: action plan: (1) reproduce minimal example to isolate detok vs tokenization vs kernel math, (2) bisect q4 kernel change, (3) run tiny beam outputs to inspect kv-cache aliasing maybe causing surrogate splits
marcos: I'll take bisect on the q4 kernels (start from the last q4 commit before file:///build/quant-kernels/main.c was touched). ping me when you have a repro script
li-chen: prepping a small repro with three lines that show the behavior. will post gist. For now, temp mitigation: pin detok-heuristic to stable for q4 onboard until we fix.
kenji: +1 to mitigation. Also add an eval that focuses on mixed-script bracket/paren reflow and crouch-level kana joins — we don't have a targeted metric for ruby/furigana splits yet
aisha: I'll add a tiny eval in the multimodel suite: 200 synthetic examples mixing ja/zh/ar with parentheses, quotes, and ruby annotations. Metric: grapheme-level continuity score + BLEU.
li-chen: thanks. I'll roll back the detok flag in the staging recipe and re-run nightly. tagging @marcos for kernel bisect once repro gist is up. :thumbsup:
marcos: will start bisect after lunch, will post a status thread
eval-bot: nightly smoke scheduled with stable detok for q4 at 03:00 UTC
li-chen: leaving logs and sample diffs in the thread artifacts; will update when bisect narrows down suspect commit.
